   191→export type InitOptions = {
   192→    /**
   193→     * Sometimes, with the local API, you might need to pass a config file directly, for example, serverless on Vercel
   194→     * The passed config should match the config file, and if it doesn't, there could be mismatches between the admin UI
   195→     * and the backend functionality
   196→     */
   197→    config: Promise<SanitizedConfig> | SanitizedConfig;
   198→    /**
   199→     * If set to `true`, payload will initialize crons for things like autorunning jobs on initialization.
   200→     *
   201→     * @default false
   202→     */
   203→    cron?: boolean;
   204→    /**
   205→     * Disable connect to the database on init
   206→     */
   207→    disableDBConnect?: boolean;
   208→    /**
   209→     * Disable running of the `onInit` function
   210→     */
   211→    disableOnInit?: boolean;
   212→    importMap?: ImportMap;
   213→    /**
   214→     * A function that is called immediately following startup that receives the Payload instance as it's only argument.
   215→     */
   216→    onInit?: (payload: Payload) => Promise<void> | void;
   217→};
   218→/**
   219→ * This result is calculated on the server
   220→ * and then sent to the client allowing the dashboard to show accessible data and actions.
   221→ *
   222→ * If the result is `true`, the user has access.
   223→ * If the result is an object, it is interpreted as a MongoDB query.
   224→ *
   225→ * @example `{ createdBy: { equals: id } }`
   226→ *
   227→ * @example `{ tenant: { in: tenantIds } }`
   228→ *
   229→ * @see https://payloadcms.com/docs/access-control/overview
   230→ */
   231→export type AccessResult = boolean | Where;
   232→export type AccessArgs<TData = any> = {
   233→    /**
   234→     * The relevant resource that is being accessed.
   235→     *
   236→     * `data` is null when a list is requested
   237→     */
   238→    data?: TData;
   239→    /** ID of the resource being accessed */
   240→    id?: DefaultDocumentIDType;
   241→    /** If true, the request is for a static file */
   242→    isReadingStaticFile?: boolean;
   243→    /** The original request that requires an access check */
   244→    req: PayloadRequest;
   245→};
   246→/**
   247→ * Access function runs on the server
   248→ * and is sent to the client allowing the dashboard to show accessible data and actions.
   249→ *
   250→ * @see https://payloadcms.com/docs/access-control/overview
   251→ */
   252→export type Access<TData = any> = (args: AccessArgs<TData>) => AccessResult | Promise<AccessResult>;
   253→/** Web Request/Response model, but the req has more payload specific properties added to it. */
   254→export type PayloadHandler = (req: PayloadRequest) => Promise<Response> | Response;
   255→/**
   256→ * Docs: https://payloadcms.com/docs/rest-api/overview#custom-endpoints
   257→ */
   258→export type Endpoint = {
   259→    /** Extension point to add your custom data. */
   260→    custom?: Record<string, any>;
   261→    /**
   262→     * Middleware that will be called when the path/method matches
   263→     *
   264→     * Compatible with Web Request/Response Model
   265→     */
   266→    handler: PayloadHandler;
   267→    /** HTTP method */
   268→    method: 'connect' | 'delete' | 'get' | 'head' | 'options' | 'patch' | 'post' | 'put';
   269→    /**
   270→     * Pattern that should match the path of the incoming request
   271→     *
   272→     * Compatible with the Express router
   273→     */
   274→    path: string;
   275→    /**
   276→     * Please add "root" routes under the /api folder in the Payload Project.
   277→     * https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route
   278→     *
   279→     * @deprecated in 3.0
   280→     */
   281→    root?: never;
   282→};

   354→export type Locale = {
   355→    /**
   356→     * value of supported locale
   357→     * @example "en"
   358→     */
   359→    code: string;
   360→    /**
   361→     * Code of another locale to use when reading documents with fallback, if not specified defaultLocale is used
   362→     */
   363→    fallbackLocale?: string | string[];
   364→    /**
   365→     * label of supported locale
   366→     * @example "English"
   367→     */

   369→    /**
   370→     * if true, defaults textAligmnent on text fields to RTL

   372→    rtl?: boolean;
   373→};
   374→export type BaseLocalizationConfig = {
   375→    /**
   376→     * Locale for users that have not expressed their preference for a specific locale
   377→     * @example `"en"`
   378→     */
   379→    defaultLocale: string;
   380→    /**
   381→     * Change the locale used by the default Publish button.
   382→     * If set to `all`, all locales will be published.
   383→     * If set to `active`, only the locale currently being edited will be published.
   384→     * The non-default option will be available via the secondary button.
   385→     * @default 'all'
   386→     */
   387→    defaultLocalePublishOption?: 'active' | 'all';
   388→    /** Set to `true` to let missing values in localised fields fall back to the values in `defaultLocale`
   389→     *
   390→     * If false, then no requests will fallback unless a fallbackLocale is specified in the request.
   391→     * @default true
   392→     */
   393→    fallback?: boolean;
   394→    /**
   395→     * Define a function to filter the locales made available in Payload admin UI
   396→     * based on user.
   397→     */
   398→    filterAvailableLocales?: (args: {
   399→        locales: Locale[];
   400→        req: PayloadRequest;
   401→    }) => Locale[] | Promise<Locale[]>;
   402→};
   403→export type LocalizationConfigWithNoLabels = Prettify<{

   456→export type FetchAPIFileUploadOptions = {
   457→    /**
   458→     * Returns a HTTP 413 when the file is bigger than the size limit if `true`.
   459→     * Otherwise, it will add a `truncated = true` to the resulting file structure.
   460→     * @default false
   461→     */
   462→    abortOnLimit?: boolean | undefined;
   463→    /**
   464→     * Automatically creates the directory path specified in `.mv(filePathName)`
   465→     * @default false
   466→     */
   467→    createParentPath?: boolean | undefined;
   468→    /**
   469→     * Turn on/off upload process logging. Can be useful for troubleshooting.
   470→     * @default false
   471→     */
   472→    debug?: boolean | undefined;
   473→    /**
   474→     * User defined limit handler which will be invoked if the file is bigger than configured limits.
   475→     * @default false
   476→     */
   477→    limitHandler?: ((args: {
   478→        request: Request;
   479→        size: number;
   480→    }) => void) | boolean | undefined;
   481→    /**
   482→     * By default, `req.body` and `req.files` are flattened like this:
   483→     * `{'name': 'John', 'hobbies[0]': 'Cinema', 'hobbies[1]': 'Bike'}
   484→     *
   485→     * When this option is enabled they are parsed in order to be nested like this:
   486→     * `{'name': 'John', 'hobbies': ['Cinema', 'Bike']}`
   487→     * @default false
   488→     */
   489→    parseNested?: boolean | undefined;
   490→    /**
   491→     * Preserves filename extension when using `safeFileNames` option.
   492→     * If set to `true`, will default to an extension length of `3`.
   493→     * If set to `number`, this will be the max allowable extension length.
   494→     * If an extension is smaller than the extension length, it remains untouched. If the extension is longer,
   495→     * it is shifted.
   496→     * @default false
   497→     *
   498→     * @example
   499→     * // true
   500→     * app.use(fileUpload({ safeFileNames: true, preserveExtension: true }));
   501→     * // myFileName.ext --> myFileName.ext
   502→     *
   503→     * @example
   504→     * // max extension length 2, extension shifted
   505→     * app.use(fileUpload({ safeFileNames: true, preserveExtension: 2 }));
   506→     * // myFileName.ext --> myFileNamee.xt
   507→     */
   508→    preserveExtension?: boolean | number | undefined;
   509→    /**
   510→     * Response which will be send to client if file size limit exceeded when `abortOnLimit` set to `true`.
   511→     * @default 'File size limit has been reached'
   512→     */
   513→    responseOnLimit?: string | undefined;
   514→    /**
   515→     * Strips characters from the upload's filename.
   516→     * You can use custom regex to determine what to strip.
   517→     * If set to `true`, non-alphanumeric characters _except_ dashes and underscores will be stripped.
   518→     * This option is off by default.
   519→     * @default false
   520→     *
   521→     * @example
   522→     * // strip slashes from file names
   523→     * app.use(fileUpload({ safeFileNames: /\\/g }))
   524→     *
   525→     * @example
   526→     * app.use(fileUpload({ safeFileNames: true }))
   527→     */
   528→    safeFileNames?: boolean | RegExp | undefined;
   529→    /**
   530→     * Path to store temporary files.
   531→     * Used along with the `useTempFiles` option. By default this module uses `'tmp'` folder
   532→     * in the current working directory.
   533→     * You can use trailing slash, but it is not necessary.
   534→     * @default 'tmp'
   535→     */
   536→    tempFileDir?: string | undefined;
   537→    /**
   538→     * This defines how long to wait for data before aborting. Set to `0` if you want to turn off timeout checks.
   539→     * @default 60_000
   540→     */
   541→    uploadTimeout?: number | undefined;
   542→    /**
   543→     * Applies uri decoding to file names if set `true`.
   544→     * @default false
   545→     */
   546→    uriDecodeFileNames?: boolean | undefined;
   547→    /**
   548→     * By default this module uploads files into RAM.
   549→     * Setting this option to `true` turns on using temporary files instead of utilising RAM.
   550→     * This avoids memory overflow issues when uploading large files or in case of uploading
   551→     * lots of files at same time.
   552→     * @default false
   553→     */
   554→    useTempFiles?: boolean | undefined;
   555→} & Partial<BusboyConfig>;

   593→export type WidgetWidth = 'full' | 'large' | 'medium' | 'small' | 'x-large' | 'x-small';
   594→export type Widget = {
   595→    Component: PayloadComponent;
   596→    fields?: Field[];
   597→    /**
   598→     * Human-friendly label for the widget.

   600→     * If not provided, the label will be auto-generated from the slug.
   601→     */

   604→    minWidth?: WidgetWidth;
   605→    slug: string;
   606→};
   607→/**

   609→ */
   610→export type ClientWidget = {

   614→    minWidth?: WidgetWidth;
   615→    slug: string;
   616→};
   617→export type WidgetInstance<TSlug extends WidgetSlug = WidgetSlug> = TSlug extends WidgetSlug ? {
   618→    data?: DataFromWidgetSlug<TSlug> extends Record<string, unknown> ? DataFromWidgetSlug<TSlug> : Record<string, unknown>;
   619→    widgetSlug: TSlug;
   620→    width: [
   621→        Extract<TypedWidget[TSlug] extends {
   622→            width: infer TWidth;
   623→        } ? TWidth : WidgetWidth, WidgetWidth>
   624→    ] extends [never] ? WidgetWidth : Extract<TypedWidget[TSlug] extends {
   625→        width: infer TWidth;
   626→    } ? TWidth : WidgetWidth, WidgetWidth>;
   627→} : never;

   642→export type Config = {

   746→            settingsMenu?: CustomComponent[];
   747→            /**
   748→             * Replace or modify top-level admin routes, or add new ones:
   749→             * + `Account` - `/admin/account`
   750→             * + `Dashboard` - `/admin`
   751→             * + `:path` - `/admin/:path`

   755→                [key: string]: AdminViewConfig;

   758→                /** Replace the admin homepage */
   759→                dashboard?: AdminViewConfig;
   760→            };
   761→        };

   763→        custom?: Record<string, any>;
   764→        /**
   765→         * Customize the dashboard widgets
   766→         * @experimental This prop is subject to change in future releases.
   767→         */
   768→        dashboard?: DashboardConfig;
   769→        /** Global date format that will be used for all dates in the Admin panel. Any valid date-fns format pattern can be used. */
   770→        dateFormat?: string;
   771→        /**
   772→         * Each entry in this map generates an entry in the importMap.
   773→         */
   774→        dependencies?: AdminDependencies;
   775→        /**
   776→         * @deprecated
   777→         * This option is deprecated and will be removed in v4.
   778→         * To disable the admin panel itself, delete your `/app/(payload)/admin` directory.
   779→         * To disable all REST API and GraphQL endpoints, delete your `/app/(payload)/api` directory.
   780→         * Note: If you've modified the default paths via `admin.routes`, delete those directories instead.
   781→         */
   782→        disable?: boolean;
   783→        importMap?: {
   784→            /**
   785→             * Automatically generate component map during development
   786→             * @default true
   787→             */
   788→            autoGenerate?: boolean;
   789→            /**
   790→             * The base directory for component paths starting with /.
   791→             * @default process.cwd()
   792→             **/
   793→            baseDir?: string;
   794→            /**
   795→             * You can use generators to add custom components to the component import map.
   796→             * This allows you to import custom components in the admin panel.
   797→             */
   798→            generators?: ImportMapGenerators;
   799→            /**
   800→             * If Payload cannot find the import map file location automatically,
   801→             * you can manually provide it here.
   802→             */
   803→            importMapFile?: string;
   804→        };
   805→        /**
   806→         * Live Preview options.
   807→         *

  1161→     */
  1162→    queryPresets?: {
  1163→        /**
  1164→         * Define collection-level access control that applies to all presets globally.
  1165→         * This is separate from document-level access (constraints) which users can configure per-preset.
  1166→         */
  1167→        access: {
  1168→            create?: Access<QueryPreset>;
  1169→            delete?: Access<QueryPreset>;
  1170→            read?: Access<QueryPreset>;
  1171→            update?: Access<QueryPreset>;
  1172→        };
  1173→        /**
  1174→         * Define custom document-level access control options for presets.
  1175→         *
  1176→         * Payload provides sensible defaults (Only Me, Everyone, Specific Users), but you can
  1177→         * add custom constraints for more complex patterns like RBAC.
  1178→         *
  1179→         * @example
  1180→         * ```ts
  1181→         * constraints: {
  1182→         *   read: [
  1183→         *     {
  1184→         *       label: 'Specific Roles',
  1185→         *       value: 'specificRoles',
  1186→         *       fields: [
  1187→         *         {
  1188→         *           name: 'roles',
  1189→         *           type: 'select',
  1190→         *           hasMany: true,
  1191→         *           options: [
  1192→         *             { label: 'Admin', value: 'admin' },
  1193→         *             { label: 'User', value: 'user' },
  1194→         *           ],
  1195→         *         },
  1196→         *       ],
  1197→         *       access: ({ req: { user } }) => ({
  1198→         *         'access.read.roles': { in: [user?.roles] },
  1199→         *       }),
  1200→         *     },
  1201→         *   ],
  1202→         * }
  1203→         * ```
  1204→         *
  1205→         * @see https://payloadcms.com/docs/query-presets/overview#custom-access-control
  1206→         */
  1207→        constraints: {
  1208→            create?: QueryPresetConstraints;
  1209→            delete?: QueryPresetConstraints;
  1210→            read?: QueryPresetConstraints;
  1211→            update?: QueryPresetConstraints;
  1212→        };
  1213→        /**
  1214→         * Used to dynamically filter which constraints are available based on the current user, document data,
  1215→         * or other criteria.
  1216→         *
  1217→         * Some examples of this might include:
  1218→         *
  1219→         * - Ensuring that only "admins" are allowed to make a preset available to "everyone"
  1220→         * - Preventing the "onlyMe" option from being selected based on a hypothetical "disablePrivatePresets" checkbox
  1221→         *
  1222→         * When a user lacks the permission to set a constraint, the option will either be hidden from them, or disabled if it is already saved to that preset.
  1223→         *
  1224→         * @see https://payloadcms.com/docs/query-presets/overview#constraint-access-control
  1225→         */

  1227→        labels?: CollectionConfig['labels'];

  1279→         * Automatically generate types during development
  1280→         * @default true
  1281→         */
  1282→        autoGenerate?: boolean;
  1283→        /** Disable declare block in generated types file */
  1284→        declare?: {
  1285→            /**
  1286→             * @internal internal use only to allow for multiple declarations within a monorepo and suppress the "Duplicate identifier GeneratedTypes" error
  1287→             *
  1288→             * Adds a @ts-ignore flag above the GeneratedTypes interface declaration
  1289→             *
  1290→             * @default false
  1291→             */
  1292→            ignoreTSError?: boolean;
  1293→        } | false;
  1294→        /** Filename to write the generated types to */
  1295→        outputFile?: string;
  1296→        /**
  1297→         * Post-process the generated TypeScript types string before writing to file.
  1298→         * Useful for plugins that need to inject generic types that JSON Schema cannot express.
  1299→         *
  1300→         * Functions are applied in order after the built-in Select generics are added.
  1301→         *
  1302→         * @example
  1303→         * ```ts
  1304→         * postProcess: [
  1305→         *   ({ compiledTypes, config }) => {
  1306→         *     const genericType = `export type MyGeneric<T> = { value: T };`
  1307→         *     return compiledTypes.replace(/(\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/\n)/, `$1\n${genericType}\n`)
  1308→         *   },
  1309→         * ]
  1310→         * ```
  1311→         */
  1312→        postProcess?: Array<(args: {
  1313→            compiledTypes: string;
  1314→            config: SanitizedConfig;
  1315→        }) => string>;
  1316→        /**
  1317→         * Allows you to modify the base JSON schema that is generated during generate:types. This JSON schema will be used
  1318→         * to generate the TypeScript interfaces.
  1319→         */
  1320→        schema?: Array<(args: {
  1321→            collectionIDFieldTypes: {
  1322→                [key: string]: 'number' | 'string';
  1323→            };
  1324→            config: SanitizedConfig;
  1325→            i18n: I18n;
  1326→            jsonSchema: JSONSchema4;
  1327→        }) => JSONSchema4>;
  1328→        /**
  1329→         * Enable strict type safety for draft operations. When enabled, the `draft` parameter is forbidden
  1330→         * on collections without drafts, and query results with `draft: true` type required fields as optional.
  1331→         * This prevents invalid draft usage at compile time and ensures type correctness across all Local API operations.
  1332→         *
  1333→         * @default false
  1334→         * @todo Remove in v4. Strict draft types will become the default behavior.
  1335→         */
  1336→        strictDraftTypes?: boolean;
  1337→    };
  1338→    /**
  1339→     * Customize the handling of incoming file uploads for collections that have uploads enabled.
  1340→     */
  1341→    upload?: FetchAPIFileUploadOptions;
  1342→};
  1343→/**
  1344→ * @todo remove the `DeepRequired` in v4.
  1345→ * We don't actually guarantee that all properties are set when sanitizing configs.
  1346→ */
  1347→export type SanitizedConfig = {
  1348→    admin: {
  1349→        timezones: SanitizedTimezoneConfig;
  1350→    } & DeepRequired<Config['admin']>;
  1351→    blocks?: FlattenedBlock[];
  1352→    collections: SanitizedCollectionConfig[];
  1353→    /** Default richtext editor to use for richText fields */
  1354→    editor?: RichTextAdapter<any, any, any>;
  1355→    endpoints: Endpoint[];
  1356→    globals: SanitizedGlobalConfig[];
  1357→    i18n: Required<I18nOptions>;
  1358→    jobs: SanitizedJobsConfig;
  1359→    localization: false | SanitizedLocalizationConfig;
  1360→    paths: {
  1361→        config: string;
  1362→        configDir: string;
  1363→        rawConfig: string;
  1364→    };
  1365→    upload: {
  1366→        /**
  1367→         * Deduped list of adapters used in the project
  1368→         */
  1369→        adapters: string[];
  1370→    } & FetchAPIFileUploadOptions;
  1371→} & Omit<DeepRequired<Config>, 'admin' | 'blocks' | 'collections' | 'editor' | 'endpoint' | 'globals' | 'i18n' | 'jobs' | 'localization' | 'upload'>;
  1372→export type EditConfig = EditConfigWithoutRoot | EditConfigWithRoot;
  1373→/**
  1374→ * Replace or modify _all_ nested document views and routes, including the document header, controls, and tabs. This cannot be used in conjunction with other nested views.
  1375→ * + `root` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/**\/*`
  1376→ * @link https://payloadcms.com/docs/custom-components/document-views#document-root
  1377→ */
  1378→export type EditConfigWithRoot = {
  1379→    api?: never;
  1380→    default?: never;
  1381→    livePreview?: never;
  1382→    root: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1383→    version?: never;
  1384→    versions?: never;
  1385→};
  1386→type KnownEditKeys = 'api' | 'default' | 'livePreview' | 'root' | 'version' | 'versions';
  1387→/**
  1388→ * Replace or modify individual nested routes, or add new ones:
  1389→ * + `default` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id`
  1390→ * + `api` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/api`
  1391→ * + `livePreview` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/preview`
  1392→ * + `references` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/references`
  1393→ * + `relationships` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/relationships`
  1394→ * + `versions` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/versions`
  1395→ * + `version` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/versions/:version`
  1396→ * + `customView` - `/admin/collections/:collection/:id/:path`
  1397→ *
  1398→ * To override the entire Edit View including all nested views, use the `root` key.
  1399→ *
  1400→ * @link https://payloadcms.com/docs/custom-components/document-views
  1401→ */
  1402→export type EditConfigWithoutRoot = {
  1403→    [K in Exclude<string, KnownEditKeys>]: CustomDocumentViewConfig;
  1404→} & {
  1405→    api?: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1406→    default?: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1407→    livePreview?: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1408→    root?: never;
  1409→    version?: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1410→    versions?: DefaultDocumentViewConfig;
  1411→};
  1412→export type EntityDescriptionComponent = CustomComponent;
  1413→export type EntityDescriptionFunction = ({ t }: {
  1414→    t: TFunction;
  1415→}) => string;
  1416→export type EntityDescription = EntityDescriptionFunction | Record<string, string> | string;
  1417→export type { EmailAdapter, SendEmailOptions };
  1418→//# sourceMappingURL=types.d.ts.map
